Context: 9. Benefits to the families of Government servants who go missing during service

If a Government servant goes missing during service and his family is given family pension under CCS (Pension) Rules or CCS (EOP) Rules, the PRAN under National Pension System would remain suspended till he re-appears or till he is declared dead in accordance with the law. In the event of his re-appearance, the NPS account would be re-activated and the same account under NPS will become operative. Recoveries of payments made to the family of missing NPS employee would be made from the indemner as provided
